title: The Custodians
summary: The Recall Authority issues warrants; tendered companies carry them into fields where an attestation is only as strong as its guard.
body: The Recall Authority is not an employer. It is a Continuance office that compares surviving root collars with Compact records and declares what the old charter still names. The work beyond its readers is let by custody tender to companies prepared to field sealed machines under Continuance rules.

A custodian company does not command a hidden obedience in any Tessell cockpit. Its reader can attest a serial, open a certified dock and make a warrant legible. It cannot start a reactor, steer a leg or move a gun. Custody still has to cross the ground under armour.

The Tender supplies warrants, not parts. Sealed capacitors and reactor cases cannot be replaced in a local yard, and certified work takes time the contract does not forgive. Custodians are paid to return roots intact; they are expected to keep their own company solvent while doing it.

Foundry rebuilds offend the archive and remain useful machines. Their plates can be sold, but fitting them to Aurelian Stock turns a warrant company into the evidence it was sent to collect. The Tender calls salvage a distraction. The workshop calls it somebody else's inventory.
